title: Seasick Cellar
description: A hollow FM sub-bass that drifts in pitch and wobbles like it's underwater. A slow deep vibrato makes the low end seasick while the FM index and harmonicity creep on separate clocks, and a downward pitch-envelope click thumps each note into place. Dry, dark, and unstable.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 eb1 f1 g0>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(23).range(3, 11))
    .fmh("<1.5 1 2 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<-12 -7 -10 -5>/2").pattack(0.005).pdecay(0.09)
    .vib(perlin.slow(29).range(2.5, 6.5))
    .vibmod(saw.slow(16).range(0.4, 1.1))
    .lpf(saw.slow(13).range(220, 900))
    .resonance(sine.slow(11).range(6, 15))
    .ftype("ladder")
    .shape(tri.slow(17).range(0.15, 0.45))
    .off(0.012, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .gain(0.92)
)
